finalOutput.finalAnswer:
Implemented scoped-class propagation for cascade-mode descendants and fixed static attribute serialization so appended scoped classes survive `innerHTML` generation. The key fix is that static attribute stringification now joins all text chunks instead of only the first one, which was dropping appended `svelte-*` classes on nested children. I also added a regression sample covering the reported `.cl1 .cl2` static-child case, and aligned DOM/SSR scoped-class checks to use inherited cascade scoping.

Verification: `npm run build` succeeded. The focused regression passed with `./node_modules/.bin/mocha --opts mocha.opts test/css/index.js --grep "cascade-nested-class-static-child"`. I also ran the broader `./node_modules/.bin/mocha --opts mocha.opts`, where the relevant CSS suite passed including the new sample; the remaining 11 failures were outside the touched code paths (`custom-elements` timeouts and `runtime binding-select` failures in this local environment).
finalOutput.notes: Installed dependencies locally with `npm install` to enable build/test execution. `mocha.opts` points at `test/test.js`, so broad Mocha runs exercised the full suite rather than only the CSS file. I used the focused grep run plus the broad run output to verify the regression and confirm the CSS area stayed green.

# Verification Before Completion

Claiming work is complete without verification is dishonesty, not efficiency.

```

```

Random fixes waste time and create new bugs. Quick patches mask underlying issues.
